entries.land_location_as_stated: on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts
entries.description: Two residents on 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog and gardens on Silver Lake in Massachusetts. Offers camping and open space to women and children, farmwork experience, and apprenticeships. Working to organize a land trust. Rejects lesbian separatism. Visitors bring food and donate $4/night.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-3826. My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children. We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phone-call, preferably a letter.
entries.notes: Type: two residents ("My partner & I are the only residents") so two-woman rule gives Private/Individual Land; the land trust is only being organized ("currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust"). Mailing is a PO box so no land street/city/zip; land state MA from the listing. Accepted: "women and children" before 1986 means Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women, Girl children + Boy children. Residents 2 from "only residents". Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from farmwork experience and gardens; Workshops/education from apprenticeships. Lesbian separatism not coded because the listing rejects it ("unworkable and alienating").

entries.description: 113 acres of Maine mountains and woodland with parcels available for sale and/or building, plus camping, hiking and raspberry picking. Four lesbians live and work on the land. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, non-lesbian women and lesbians interested in buying land.
entries.raw_text: WOMONGROUND Rt 1, Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987. 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking. Will answer all letters promptly. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.
entries.notes: Land address copied from the rural route mailing address. Type: 4 lesbians living on the land and recruiting "new members/residents", so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Residents 4 from "4 lesbians" with "women working and living on the land". Accepted: Non-lesbian women and Girl children named; Lesbian women named. Setting phrase "Maine mountains/woodland" kept as stated.

entries.description: 20 acres with creek, woods and open land and two dyke-built dwellings, with no plumbing or electricity. The collective owners do not live there; it is rented to heterosexuals, and they are interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs.
entries.raw_text: GENEROUS EARTH LAND Box 51A, Hinesburg, VT 05461. 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity. None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.
entries.notes: Type: owned by a "dyke collective", so Intentional Community/Cooperative, although owners do not live there now. Residents 0 from "None of the dyke collective owners live there now"; renters are tenants from outside. Accepted: "Interested in dyke renters" means Lesbian women. Mailing is a PO box so no land street/zip; land state VT from the mailing state.

entries.description: Working homestead farm offering year-round space to women needing retreat or temporary living, with secluded land and campsites. Plans visitor cabins. Offers x-country ski weekends and summer work exchange, an all-lesbian maple sugar bush, a draft horse, dairy goats and chickens, and workshops. Vegetarians raising nearly all their food organically. Welcomes community members and leases land to women wanting to build a cabin or tipi.
entries.raw_text: GREENHOPE Box 226, E Hardwick, VT 05836. (802)533-7772. At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends — $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush — the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We are vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here.
